labware.addLabwareDefinition.description: Registers a new labware definition from an inline definition object.

labware.getLabwareDefinition.description: Returns a labware definition by name.

labware.getLabwareDefinitions.description: Returns all labware definitions, optionally filtered by type.

labware.getLabwareTypes.description: Returns the list of supported labware type categories.

labware.importLabwareDefinition.description: Imports a labware definition from a .rck file.

liquidClass.getLiquidClass.description: Returns the full definition of a liquid class by name.

liquidClass.getLiquidClasses.description: Returns liquid class names matching the given filter criteria.

liquidClass.getLiquidDevices.description: Returns the list of liquid handling devices (channels, heads) available for liquid classes.

liquidClass.getLiquidNames.description: Returns the list of defined liquid names.

liquidClass.getTipTypes.description: Returns the list of defined tip types and their properties.

liquidClass.pullLiquidClasses.description: Exports liquid class definitions by name.

liquidClass.pushLiquidClasses.description: Imports liquid class definitions by name.

liquidClass.updateLiquidClass.description: Updates an existing liquid class definition.

tipPool.getAvailableTips.description: Returns the available (unused) tip positions in a tip pool.

tipPool.getEmptyTips.description: Returns the empty (already used) tip positions in a tip pool.

tipPool.getMissingRacks.description: Returns the tip racks expected but missing from a tip pool.

tipPool.getTipCounter.description: Returns the full tip counter state for a tip pool.

tipPool.getTipCounters.description: Returns the list of defined tip counter names.

tipPool.initializeTipCounter.description: Initializes a tip pool's tip counter to full.

tipPool.resetTipCounter.description: Resets a tip pool's tip counter to full.

tipPool.setTipCounter.description: Sets the available tip positions for a tip pool.

tipPool.showTipCounter.description: Displays the current tip counter state for a tip pool in VENUS.

tipPool.showTipCounters.description: Displays the current tip counter state for one or more tip pools in VENUS. Shows every tip pool if tipPools is omitted.
